abstract.p: Solid or liquid N-H free, C-free, and Si-rich perhydropolysilazane compositions comprising units having the following formula [-N(SiH<sub>3</sub>)<sub>x</sub>(SiH<sub>2</sub>-)<sub>y</sub>], wherein x=0, 1, or 2 and y= 0, 1, or 2 when x+y=2; and x= 0, 1 or 2 and y=1, 2, or 3 when x+y=3 are disclosed. Also disclosed are synthesis methods and applications for the same.
